contract.sampler: natural uniform active-agent train-row sampling with replacement
contract.mc_target: exact individual realized full-episode MC return
contract.bellman_target: individual reward + gamma*(1-done)*Q_target(next local observation, frozen canonical BC argmax action)
contract.target_copy: copy previous online Q only between outer blocks

mc_control.rule: finite curves and final Q-std ratio <=5 and final RMSE ratio <=3

iterative_bellman.rule: finite curves and final Q-std ratio <=5 and final RMSE ratio <=3
